mapper.insert: insert into file_base.t_direct_upload_records(direct_upload_id, user_code, enterprise_code, object_location, expiration, file_id, original_filename, buss_type, addition) values (#{model.directUploadId}, #{model.userCode}, #{model.enterpriseCode}, #{model.objectLocation}, #{model.expiration}, #{model.fileId}, #{model.originalFilename}, #{model.bussType}, #{model.addition})
mapper.select: select * from file_base.t_direct_upload_records where expiration < now() limit 100
